t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice was to go with the "good" options Tall Purple Tall pink and short neon green  short red gnomes. However, they were switched along the line in the game that is Tall purple with short neon green. I reckon it was no stress as it is just a game.

vb_textbox.text: Prior to the advice i was given and followed, the "good" options were truly Tall purple Tall Blue because they worked mostly for me at the beginning of the game. However, as the game proceeds deep in Tall pink Tall brown made high number of mushrooms especially during the "x5" stage of the game. As usual no stress and it was all fun. Just trust your instincts.
